rules.name: Agile
rules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Blast
rules.description: If the target is hit all models within 4“ of it are also hit by this weapon.

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Bravery Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Deathstrike
rules.description: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Mischievous
rules.description: If this model has Mischievous, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Mischievous (instead of only results of 6).

rules.name: Enhanced Mischievous Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Mischievous. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Vicious
rules.description: If this model has Vicious, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Vicious (instead of only results of 6).

rules.name: Good Shot
rules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

rules.name: Hazardous
rules.description: Gets AP(4), but on unmodified results of 1 to hit this model takes one wound, or X wounds if this weapon has the Blast(X)/Deadly(X) rule.

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Imprecise
rules.description: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Instinctive
rules.description: When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, then it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack.

rules.name: Melee Evasion
rules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

rules.name: Melee Evasion Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Evasion. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Mischievous
rules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

rules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Quick
rules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Quick Shot
rules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

rules.name: Quick Shot Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Quick Shot. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Re-Deployment
rules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Retaliate
rules.description: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
rules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

rules.name: Vicious
rules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

spells.name: Ammo Boost
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Mischievous once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Boom!
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 1 hit with Blast(3).

spells.name: Mob Frenzy
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Shooter against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Pow!
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Hazardous. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 1" effects trigger.

spells.name: Shroud Field
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Zap!
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.
